    AI Overview
    Giorgia Meloni is the current Prime Minister of Italy, having assumed office on October 22, 2022. She is the first woman to hold this position in Italian history. 
    Key Information (as of April 2026): 
    • Political Party: She is the leader of the right-wing party Brothers of Italy (Fratelli d'Italia).
    • Recent Developments:
      • As of mid-April 2026, Meloni has faced public criticism from U.S. President Donald Trump over her refusal to support the U.S.-Israel war on Iran.
      • She has recently distanced herself from the U.S. administration, including defending Pope Leo XIV against criticism from Trump.
      • In April 2026, she announced that Italy would not renew its defense agreement with Israel, citing the ongoing Middle East conflict.
      • She continues to advocate for security guarantees for Ukraine, including a proposal modeled on NATO's Article 5.
    • Government Role: She heads a right-wing coalition government. 
    She serves as the President of the Council of Ministers.

    What does Giorgia Meloni believe in?

    Is Meloni right or left?
    The party is led by Giorgia Meloni, the incumbent Prime Minister of Italy. Meloni's tenure has been described as the "most right-wing" government in Italy since World War II, whilst her time in government is variously described as a shift towards the far-right in Italian politics.

    Who is higher, president or Prime Minister in Italy?
    The formal Italian order of precedence lists the office as being ceremonially the fourth-highest Italian state office after the president and the presiding officers of the two houses of the Italian Parliament. In practice, the prime minister is the country's political leader and de facto chief executive.
